description: Figure 4 (RIGHT) illustrates the relationship between Accuracy@1 (%) on geometry problems from the Geomverse dataset and the tree width, defined as the number of child nodes, for rollout search. The x-axis is labeled "Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 1 to 7, with tick labels at integer intervals. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)" and also uses a linear scale, ranging from 15 to 35, with tick labels at 5-unit intervals. Two lines are plotted: a solid blue line with circular markers representing GPT-4o, and a dashed light blue line with triangular markers representing Claude-3.5-Sonnet. The GPT-4o line begins at 24.4% accuracy when the tree width is 1, rises to a peak of 34.4% at a tree width of 5, and then declines to 31.1% at a tree width of 7. The Claude-3.5-Sonnet line begins at 26.7% accuracy when the tree width is 1, decreases to 24.4% at a tree width of 5, and continues to decline to 20.0% at a tree width of 7.
